approach: Static PowerPC-to-C++ recompilation to native Windows x64 using ReXGlue 0.10.0 and the Xenos GPU backend.
notes: Early development, single-player only. Saint-Lo and Island have been completed in manual testing; Night Drop loads with player control but full completion is unverified. Saint-Lo-to-Island, Island-to-Night-Drop and menu/Continue transitions work in the same process/window in tested builds. Scoped grass, shadow-material and lantern-glow corrections have been checked in specific scenes. Remaining work includes campaign modules, spatial audio, integrated PC menus/input and broader stability testing. Original user-owned Xbox 360 game assets are required.
